title: Basic katakana: S and T rows — find the sign
description: Choose the written sign from three visible kana using a basic sound or specified spelling context. 10 independent targets.

review.provenance: Independent agent-authored katakana sign cues and feedback; no CSV or mock text reused.
review.rightsBasis: Original agent-authored English copy and glosses; katakana correspondences are linguistic facts. No third-party text or audio used.

exercises.prompt: Which katakana sign has the basic reading conventionally written sa in Latin letters?

text.gloss: Katakana sign for the basic sa reading.
Katakana sign for the basic shi reading.
Katakana sign for the basic su reading.

exercises.explanation: サ is the katakana sign for the written sa cue. Katakana sign for the basic sa reading. Different written forms are not interchangeable by sound alone.
